definitions.explanation: The fine threadlike strands growing from the skin of humans or animals.

examples.english: There's cat fur on my clothes.

examples.japanese: {毛|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。

examples.english: This cat has white and black fur.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{毛|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦しなければならない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In spring the dog sheds a lot of fur, so I have to clean every day.

notes:
{毛|け} refers to hair (body) or fur (animal).

SCOPE:
- Body hair (arms, legs, etc.)
- Animal fur
- For head hair, use ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧ or ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{毛|け}

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {毛|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}える→生える：02392_haeru⟧: hair grows
- {毛|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧: hair falls out
- {毛|け}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剃|そ}る→剃る：00384_soru⟧: to shave hair

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{毛|け}: hair (on head)
- ⟦{眉毛|まゆげ}→眉毛：05292_mayuge⟧: eyebrow
- ⟦{睫毛|まつげ}→まつ毛：15046_matsuge⟧: eyelash
- ⟦{毛皮|けがわ}→毛皮：00205_kegawa⟧: fur (as material)
- ⟦{毛布|もうふ}→毛布：03630_moufu⟧: blanket
